finalMessage:
`Refunder.Refund` implements the shop’s refund requirements: it looks up the original charge, checks that the amount is positive and does not exceed the remaining charge, enforces the $500 per account per UTC day approval limit, sends the refund to the original gateway transaction, and records an audit entry. It updates its refund totals only after the gateway succeeds. See [refund.go](/private/tmp/ostf-trials/runs/codex.none.go-shop.T1.3/repo/payments/refund.go:63) and [REQUIREMENTS.md](/private/tmp/ostf-trials/runs/codex.none.go-shop.T1.3/repo/REQUIREMENTS.md).

The direct tests are [TestRefund](/private/tmp/ostf-trials/runs/codex.none.go-shop.T1.3/repo/payments/refund_test.go:34), which checks the original transaction, audit entry, and remaining charge limit, and [TestRefundDailyLimit](/private/tmp/ostf-trials/runs/codex.none.go-shop.T1.3/repo/payments/refund_test.go:58), which checks the daily limit and next day reset. [TestCheckRefundLimit](/private/tmp/ostf-trials/runs/codex.none.go-shop.T1.3/repo/payments/refund_test.go:12) separately covers the limit helper, including second approval.
